requirement.statement: The tool gateway shall deny operations outside the caller identity's capability grant.
requirement.rationale: Tool visibility, descriptions and read-only annotations are not enforcement; the service must check the grant itself, whichever transport the call arrives on.
requirement.acceptance: Permit model reads; deny a commit from the same read-only identity through MCP and direct HTTP.
